# mini fixture

5 Synthea COVID-19 inpatients (1 ICU survivor, 1 died, 3 ward-only), all their rows from 7 tables.
Regenerate: `uv run python scripts/make_mini_fixture.py`. Later stages add `docs/`, `pages/`, `responses/` here.

`responses/ae9d4aa74840db0bfc0bd51c0edb2decee7444bd403058aeb1ee48c6199f6527.json` — recorded claude -p (Sonnet) authoring of the 5 patients' documents (S2); replayed by tests/synth/test_replay.py. Re-record with AUDITPACE_RECORD=1 after prompt/plan changes.

S3 renders the 24 replayed documents in-process (tests/render/); nothing is stored here — Chromium is required (`uv run playwright install chromium`).

S4: the other `responses/*.json` files are recorded MedGemma 1.5 4B transcripts of the mini cohort's rendered pages (one per page, keyed on prompt + model + JPEG bytes), including one page's failed `finish_reason: length` first attempt plus its retry fixture (keyed additionally on `repetition_penalty`, which the stage's retry sets to break a runaway-repetition loop); replayed by tests/read/test_replay.py. Re-record with `AUDITPACE_RECORD=1 uv run pytest tests/read/test_replay.py` after a `READ_PROMPT`, reader-model, `RETRY_REPETITION_PENALTY` or `RENDER_VERSION` change, with `ONLY=4b make serve` up.

S5: the newest `responses/*.json` files (23) are recorded MedGemma 27B adjudications of the mini cohort's applicable cases (one per case, keyed on the adjudicator model id + prompt messages + per-criterion JSON schema; the reader endpoint's readings are replayed first so the prompt bytes are stable); replayed by tests/adjudicate/test_replay.py. Re-record with `AUDITPACE_RECORD=1 uv run pytest tests/adjudicate/test_replay.py` after a `SYSTEM_PROMPT`/`USER_TEMPLATE`/`DOC_TEMPLATE`/`EVENT_GLOSS`/`REASON_GLOSS`/`reply_schema`/adjudicator-model change or any upstream change to `reading_text`, with `ONLY=27b make serve` up (27B on :8003).

S8: `responses/498f0bfd2e0f403663429da4020709773c0b99e24679498dacf257666f2f7f69.json` — recorded MedGemma 27B report prose for the S7/S8 toy processed dir (keyed on the reporter model id + system prompt + `Payload.for_model()` JSON + the prose schema); replayed by tests/report/test_replay.py. Re-recorded 2026-09-17 (fix wave 1): `Payload.for_model()` became the compact, pre-formatted view (spec §5 amendment), `SYSTEM_PROMPT` was updated to describe it, and `user_message()` switched from indented to compact (no whitespace, `ensure_ascii=False`) JSON — the indented form put the real full-cohort prompt one token over the reporter's 12,288-token context (10,241 input tokens against a 10,240 budget at max_tokens = 2048); all three changed `prompt_version` and the fixture key. The replay accepts all 11 paragraphs (0 rejections), versus the earlier fixture's payload being unrepresentative of the real cohort's 79,298-token scale. Re-record with `AUDITPACE_RECORD=1 uv run pytest tests/report/test_replay.py` after a `SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `prose_schema`, `WORD_LIMITS`, `user_message`, reporter-model or toy-fixture change, with `ONLY=27b make serve` up (27B on :8003).
